msg: Keep your fingers on the K, S and Space bar at all times. There doesn't seem to be any pattern to the number of mushrooms per gnome. I just kept mixing up the pattern of sides, gnomes etc but doesn't seem to have any effect on mushrooms. You get into a little flow with the clicking and I only timed out once. I tried not to focus too much on which side, or score number and just focused on making sure I clicked the keys in time. Have fun!
